_comment: AB-530 mainframe decommission plan. Read by tools/retirement/mainframe_decommission.py (make mainframe-decommission). Dry run by default; --execute refuses while any gate is open or on a protected branch, and the only scripted step removes the legacy trees from the working tree for review in a PR. All mainframe actions are manual and run by the named owner. See docs/pas/mainframe-decommission.md.
component: PAS mainframe components (CICS transactions and programs, CA-7 jobs, DB2 ACMEINS, legacy source trees)

decommission.name: ACME.PAS.LOADLIB (POLNEW, POLRNW, POLEND, POLQRY, UNDWRT, PREMBAT and CSD group)
migrationReverseSync and migrationDeltaSync CronJobs, acmeins_shadow schema

archive.method: DB2 UNLOAD of every table (with DDL from the catalog) after the last reverse sync, to the enterprise archive as read-only datasets; row counts and SHA-256 of each unload recorded; a sample restore into a scratch DB2 subsystem proves the archive is readable

tables.notes: PII: encrypted archive, access by Data governance approval only

repository.kept_reason: sql/ddl is the DB2 schema baseline for the compat schema check and the archive restore; it is retired by a separate decision once the archive is accepted

dependents.action: replace the legacy layout with the post-decommission layout (docs/pas/target-state.md)
freeze the copybook/JCL record layouts into compat baselines (check_layouts) and retarget compat-api from java-facade to the pas-policy-service OpenAPI contract (AB-524 G4)
historical references; keep, they cite the frozen git history
archive the COBOL characterization harness: keep the golden JSON as frozen expectations and drop the cobol/ program/stub references in parity/suites.json
ExtractParityIT reads the JCL SYSIN: move the frozen SQL into test resources
CopybookLayoutsTest reads cobol/copybooks: move the copybooks into test resources
comments and the facade contract seed: move facade data.sql into test resources
discovery inventory and parity tools read cobol/: freeze the generated inventory and retire the readers; retirement tools keep the trees as data
drop the parity and compat-api targets that run the legacy code

mips.measurement: 4-hour rolling average MSU of the PAS CICS region and PAS batch service classes from SMF type 70/72 (or the sub-capacity report), same calendar month before cutover and after decommission

gates.description: Cutover complete: make cutover reports GO and every capability in docs/pas/cutover.json is on NEW
Hypercare exit: 14 days after cutover with no Sev1/Sev2 (make cutover-hypercare)
Rollback window closed, recorded decision not to roll back
No CICS traffic on PNEW, PRWL, PEND, PQRY, PUWR for the agreed period (CICS statistics / SMF 110)
AB-524 facade retirement and AB-528 messaging decommission plans executed (all their gates approved)
DB2 archive taken, row counts and checksums verified, sample restore passed; retention approved by Compliance and Data governance
MIPS savings confirmed: mips.after_msu below mips.baseline_msu, confirmed by capacity planning/finance
Architecture docs and support runbook signed off; operations handover accepted (support-runbook.md)
Repository dependents repointed (repository.dependents) so make compat, pas-verify and CI pass without the legacy trees

steps.description: Disable and then remove CICS transactions PNEW, PRWL, PEND, PQRY, PUWR and their programs from the CSD group; remove the group from the region's GRPLIST (CEMT SET TRANSACTION(...) DISABLED first, CEDA DELETE after G4)
Remove CA-7 jobs PAS0050, PAS0100, PAS0200 (triggers, predecessors, calendars) after their last held cycle, and the related console alerts (FU-12)
Unload and archive DB2 ACMEINS per archive.tables and retention; revoke the PLT-02 transition account and Broker Portal grants; drop tablespace PASTS01 after G6
Stop and delete the migrationDeltaSync, migrationReverseSync and migrationReconciliation CronJobs and the DB2 datasource; drop schema acmeins_shadow (Flyway migration in the decommission PR)
Scratch ACME.PAS.LOADLIB members and PAS datasets (ACME.PAS.*) after the archive retention review
Repoint the repository dependents listed in repository.dependents (G9)
Remove the legacy trees cobol/, jcl/ and java-facade/ from the working tree
Open the decommission PR into main with the MIPS evidence and the signed-off docs; it is reviewed and merged by humans

signoffs.role: Compliance and Data governance (retention, PII archive)
